specification.contact: Text across 52 pages inventoried; selected rules and examples semantically read. See formal_source_inventory.

initial_native_findings.subject: Equipment identity and composition
initial_native_findings.finding: A physical unit can be identified separately from its catalog kind. A generic identifier has no built-in persistence or serial-number guarantee. Composition requires identifying the subject, since the same predicate serves other composite entities.

initial_native_findings.subject: Designed role, purpose and target
initial_native_findings.finding: A task expresses user purpose. A sensor observes, an actuator controls, and a meter adds computation or display. Capability alone supplies no record of execution.

initial_native_findings.subject: Commodity flows
initial_native_findings.finding: Consumption, production and storage relate equipment to a commodity with distinct directions. A stored commodity may differ from the one consumed.

initial_native_findings.subject: Quality and its value
initial_native_findings.finding: A quality can be generic or particular to a feature. A value can exist independently of a recorded observation. Its literal and unit are optional.

initial_native_findings.subject: Condition and its value
initial_native_findings.finding: Distinguish a reusable condition, a condition tied to a particular feature, and a value describing that condition.

initial_native_findings.subject: Capability and command contract
initial_native_findings.finding: A function groups commands. Required and optional membership conveys a support obligation at the function level. An individual device can have its own identifiable function and command.

initial_native_findings.subject: Digital exposure
initial_native_findings.finding: A service exposes a function on a network. Its operation exposes a command. This permits tracing a digital interface back to the particular capability it represents.

initial_native_findings.subject: Execution and time
initial_native_findings.finding: Differentiate command-level execution from the network operation, and the performer from the feature targeted. Result time concerns completion. Phenomenon time concerns the phenomenon. Inputs and outputs alone do not establish an effect.

initial_native_findings.subject: Conditional commodity price
initial_native_findings.finding: A device commodity-price profile describes payment or earnings under a time, state or property-value condition. This is a specialized economic meaning distinct from an interoperability profile.

remaining: Retain SRF-Q1 through SRF-Q3 at their documented scopes.

rule_findings.kind inheritance: hasDeviceKind followed by hasFunction entails hasFunction on the unit. It does not infer an invocation, installed service endpoint or successful result.
rule_findings.mandatory versus optional: The native chain from feature kind through mandatory command entails command membership. Extending the same inference to optional commands lacks chain support.
rule_findings.composites: consistsOf chains include property kinds and values as well as feature kinds. A composite property or value relationship does not establish a physical assembly.
rule_findings.typed-value attribution: A feature-specific quality has one owning feature through the functional isPropertyOfInterestOf. Functional means at most one distinct object for that property, not a universally required record.
rule_findings.execution: isExecutionOf can propagate through command kind and broader relationships. Retain instance and generic attribution separately.
rule_findings.oneM2M: TS 103 264 tables 2 and 3 assign equivalent classes and selected properties but give wider SAREF meanings to represents, consistsOf, hasInput and hasOutput. Clause 6.3 refers to TS 118 112 clause 7 for resource instantiation. No oneM2M runtime claim.
rule_findings.migration: Informative Annex B distinguishes the room temperature from the device battery and the execution from its result. The serial-number predicate in the example belongs to an extension.
rule_findings.ownership: Clauses 5.6–5.10 specify exactly one owning feature for a property/state of interest, one device for a function of interest, one function for a command of interest, one offering device for a service and one service for an operation. Deduce existence/uniqueness in the model without assuming explicit named records. Device-to-command ownership is mediated by the function.
rule_findings.state versus property: Clause 5.7 distinguishes the two modeling patterns without declaring them disjoint. Avoid forcing every physical quantity or condition into an exclusive pair of categories.

hold_register.SRF-Q1: Formal text and inventory span all 52 pages. Visual inspection and independent entailment testing were selective. No exhaustive diagram equivalence or runtime claim.
hold_register.SRF-Q2: TS 103 264 clause 6.3 cites TS 118 112 clause 7 without an edition in reference [2]. Release 3 V3.7.3 clause 7 and its resource/semantic-descriptor example were sampled. Which edition governs a particular deployment and its actual conformance remain open.
hold_register.SRF-Q3: External vocabulary definitions, requirements and test suites were not independently audited. Example-local or imported terms are not counted as Core declarations.
